install.title: Add MoeMail to your home screen
install.description: Open it from an icon next time, just like an app.
install.failed: Installation could not open. Try Install or Add to Home Screen in your browser menu.
install.iosDescription: iPhone and iPad require manual installation, not an automatic system dialog.
install.share: Tap Share; on some versions, open the browser menu first.
install.addHome: Choose Add to Home Screen. If missing, enable it under Edit Actions.
install.confirm: Keep Open as Web App enabled if shown, then tap Add.
